## Load Data

```{r load_data_packages}
library(tidyverse)

load("clean_data/data_imputed.RData")

# MMRC FLIGHT-ECPR Protocol: RV and nRV cohorts, cannulated only
flight_ecpr <- data_imp %>%
  filter(cohort %in% c("RV", "nRV"), ecmo_yn == 1)

# Standard MMRC ECPR Protocol: LFMC cohort, cannulated only
standard_ecpr <- data_imp %>%
  filter(cohort == "LFMC", ecmo_yn == 1)

# Combined for statistical tests
table_data <- data_imp %>%
  filter(ecmo_yn == 1) %>%
  mutate(protocol = if_else(cohort %in% c("RV", "nRV"), "FLIGHT", "Standard"))

cat("FLIGHT-ECPR patients:", nrow(flight_ecpr), "\n")
cat("Standard ECPR patients:", nrow(standard_ecpr), "\n")
```

```{r helper_functions, echo=FALSE}
# Format mean (SD)
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return("--")
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Format n (%)
n_pct <- function(x, condition = 1) {
  n <- sum(x == condition, na.rm = TRUE)
  total <- sum(!is.na(x))
  if (total == 0) return("--")
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, n / total * 100)
}

# Format count
n_count <- function(x) {
  sum(!is.na(x))
}

# Format p-value
format_pval <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("--")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

# Compare continuous variables (t-test or Wilcoxon based on normality)
compare_continuous <- function(x1, x2) {
  x1 <- x1[!is.na(x1)]
  x2 <- x2[!is.na(x2)]
  if (length(x1) < 2 || length(x2) < 2) return(NA)

  # Check normality with Shapiro-Wilk (needs n >= 3; default to t-test if too few)
  if (length(x1) < 3 || length(x2) < 3) return(tryCatch(t.test(x1, x2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA))
  norm1 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(head(x1, 5000))$p.value, error = function(e) 0)
  norm2 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(head(x2, 5000))$p.value, error = function(e) 0)

  if (norm1 > 0.05 && norm2 > 0.05) {
    # Both normal: use t-test
    tryCatch(t.test(x1, x2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  } else {
    # Non-normal: use Wilcoxon rank-sum, fall back to t-test on error
    tryCatch(wilcox.test(x1, x2)$p.value,
             error = function(e) tryCatch(t.test(x1, x2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA))
  }
}

# Compare categorical variables (Fisher's exact test for all comparisons)
compare_categorical <- function(var, group) {
  tbl <- table(var, group, useNA = "no")
  if (nrow(tbl) < 2 || ncol(tbl) < 2) return(NA)
  tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
}

# Compare binary variables (Fisher's exact test for all comparisons)
compare_binary <- function(x, group) {
  tbl <- table(x, group, useNA = "no")
  if (nrow(tbl) < 2 || ncol(tbl) < 2) return(NA)
  tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
}
```

## Table 2

```{r table2}
# Build table data frame
table2 <- data.frame(

  ),

  Standard_ECPR = c(
    nrow(standard_ecpr),
    "",
    "",
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$age),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$sex, 1),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$race, 1),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$race, 2),
    "",
    "",
    "N/A",
    "N/A",
    "N/A",
    "N/A",
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$ecmo_time),
    "",
    "",
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$init_rhythm, "VT/VF"),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$witnessed, 1),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$bystander_cpr, 1),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$lucas, 1),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$field_intubation, 1),
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$n_shocks),
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$lactate),
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$ph),
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$low_flow_time),
    "",
    "",
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$ecmo_days),
    mean_sd(standard_ecpr$los_days),
    n_pct(standard_ecpr$alive, 1)
  ),

  P_Value = c(
    "--",
    "",
    "",
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$age, standard_ecpr$age)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$sex, table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$race == 1, table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$race == 2, table_data$protocol)),
    "",
    "",
    "N/A",
    "N/A",
    "N/A",
    "N/A",
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$ecmo_time, standard_ecpr$ecmo_time)),
    "",
    "",
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$init_rhythm == "VT/VF", table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$witnessed, table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$bystander_cpr, table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$lucas, table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$field_intubation, table_data$protocol)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$n_shocks, standard_ecpr$n_shocks)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$lactate, standard_ecpr$lactate)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$ph, standard_ecpr$ph)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$low_flow_time, standard_ecpr$low_flow_time)),
    "",
    "",
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$ecmo_days, standard_ecpr$ecmo_days)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(flight_ecpr$los_days, standard_ecpr$los_days)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$alive, table_data$protocol))
  )
)

knitr::kable(table2, col.names = c("Variable", "MMRC FLIGHT-ECPR Protocol", "Standard MMRC ECPR Protocol", "P-Value"))
```

*Continuous variables compared using independent samples t-test (normally distributed) or Wilcoxon rank-sum test (non-normally distributed). Categorical variables compared using Fisher's exact test. Normality assessed via Shapiro-Wilk test. HEMS = Helicopter Emergency Medical Services.*

## Missingness Summary

```{r missingness, echo=FALSE}
# Show missingness for key variables
vars_of_interest <- c("age", "sex", "race", "call_to_cann_hosp_time", "hems_launch_time",
                      "hems_scene_time", "hems_flight_time", "ecmo_time", "init_rhythm",
                      "witnessed", "bystander_cpr", "lucas", "field_intubation", "n_shocks",
                      "lactate", "ph", "low_flow_time", "ecmo_days", "los_days", "alive")

missingness <- data.frame(
  Variable = vars_of_interest,
  FLIGHT_Missing = sapply(vars_of_interest, function(v) {
    if (v %in% names(flight_ecpr)) sum(is.na(flight_ecpr[[v]])) else NA
  }),
  FLIGHT_Total = nrow(flight_ecpr),
  Standard_Missing = sapply(vars_of_interest, function(v) {
    if (v %in% names(standard_ecpr)) sum(is.na(standard_ecpr[[v]])) else NA
  }),
  Standard_Total = nrow(standard_ecpr)
)

rownames(missingness) <- NULL
missingness <- missingness %>%
  mutate(
    FLIGHT_Pct = round(FLIGHT_Missing / FLIGHT_Total * 100, 1),
    Standard_Pct = round(Standard_Missing / Standard_Total * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, FLIGHT_Missing, FLIGHT_Pct, Standard_Missing, Standard_Pct)

library(kableExtra)
knitr::kable(missingness,
             col.names = c("Variable", "Missing (n)", "Missing (%)", "Missing (n)", "Missing (%)")) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "FLIGHT-ECPR" = 2, "Standard ECPR" = 2))
```
